market_summary: Late New York session trading is characterized by contracting volatility, subdued volume across all assets (all RVOL < 1.0 without yellow confirmation spikes), and consolidative price action. Precious metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD), FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD), and BTCUSD remain structurally below their respective daily VWAP and Value Areas but are hovering near key session support levels or mid-channel baselines where risk/reward is unfavorable for continuation shorts. US100 holds above VWAP and VAH but is whipsawing around its Gamma Flip in a negative amplifying GEX regime. Disciplined execution requires a full HOLD across the board to avoid low-liquidity chop.

signals.rationale: In the NEW_YORK_SESSION, price is trading below VAL (3887.86) and below POC (3978.13). Price is below VWAP (3931.80) and below EMA50 (3912.00). Price is positioned mid-channel between the lower ATR band (3865.52) and upper ATR band (3904.22), hovering around the EMA20 baseline (3884.87). CVD is BEARISH (-6.88) with a positive slope (+1.2) indicating waning downside momentum. RVOL is 0.712 with no yellow RVOL > 2.0 spikes to validate continuation. Price bounced from Session Low (3852.35) and faced rejection at Call Wall #2 (3887.78). Under GEX POSITIVE_DAMPENING regime, mean reversion is favored, but price is tightly compressed above Gamma Flip (3872.17) and below VAL/Call Wall #2, warranting a HOLD.
